prompt_en: Children parading five-pointed star lanterns through a neighborhood courtyard on Mid-Autumn night.
refined_prompt: Children parading five-pointed star lanterns through a neighborhood courtyard on Mid-Autumn night. Children carrying star-shaped lanterns, masks, and toy figurines, accompanied by adults holding traditional Vietnamese lanterns, parade through a neighborhood courtyard on the 14th to 15th night of the 8th lunar month. This festive procession marks the celebration of Tết Trung Thu, a traditional Vietnamese festival where children look forward to receiving gifts and treats from adults. As the moon rises high in the night sky, children eagerly await the full moon to sing, dance, and receive gifts, while others watch the mooncakes being devoured and lion or dragon dances being performed.
